scope.summary: Repair five PRE-EXISTING failing tests in the production_factory lib module that are invisible to MT-017's declared proof set, so the module is honestly green rather than green-by-narrow-filter.
scope.root_cause: MT-017 proof command [16] runs ONLY swarm_orchestration::production_factory::tests::factory_dispatches_official_cli_to_cli_builder, which passes. Running the WHOLE module (2026-07-30, both parallel and serial: 27 passed / 5 failed, EXIT=101) exposes five failures that the narrow filter hides. TWO DISTINCT CAUSES. (a) FOUR tests fail with PROCESS_LEDGER_DURABILITY_ACK_TIMEOUT ('START row for process_uuid ... was not durably acknowledged within 5000 ms'): byok_cloud_provider_selection_honors_anthropic_when_openai_also_configured (production_factory.rs:2712), official_cli_provider_selection_honors_requested_provider (:2812), cloud_success_dispatch_records_start_and_teardown_records_stop_and_unloads (:2631), from_vault_factory_cloud_spawn_records_start_and_stop (:3210). All four build their ledger with ledger_pair() (production_factory.rs:2263-2272), which calls LedgerBatcher::manual_for_tests - a MANUAL batcher that spawns no writer task and therefore can never durably acknowledge a START row, while record_cloud_session_start awaits exactly that ack. The passing sibling factory_dispatches_official_cli_to_cli_builder instead uses an explicit LedgerBatcher::spawn plus drain_and_join_ledger_writer, which is why it is unaffected. (b) ONE test, production_coordinator_constructs_and_rejects_unloadable_local_spawn_without_orphan (:2423), asserts matches!(err, SwarmError::FactoryFailed(_)) for a missing-artifact local spawn but receives SwarmError::LedgerFailed from the ModelLaneStore dexterity guard at coordinator.rs:992 ('ModelLaneStore-backed coordinators require SpawnRequest::with_dexterity_launch before runtime creation'), because the coordinator is built with lazy_model_lane_store() (:2274-2279). The guard fires before the factory is ever reached, so the expectation is stale.

AC-7 [ADDED 2026-07-31, latent build hazard]: tests/model_lane_crdt_support.rs is a SHARED SUPPORT MODULE, but cargo auto-discovers it as its own standalone test target with required-features = None, so it is compiled under DEFAULT features. It passes today, but the moment any test-utils-gated import is added to it the default build of handshake_core breaks - the same class of failure that already broke this packet twice (an ungated compile anchor on a cfg-gated symbol in b53f475d, and a gated import in an undeclared target in d154833b). Either declare it with required-features = ["test-utils"], or move shared support modules somewhere cargo does not auto-discover as targets. Prove the fix by running BOTH cargo check --all-targets and cargo check --features test-utils --all-targets.
scope.risk_if_missed: The production_factory module carries five silent failures. Any future WP that widens the proof filter beyond the single declared test inherits a red module and cannot tell new breakage from old. Worse, the four ack timeouts mean the cloud-session START durability path has NO honest passing coverage in this module, so a real durability regression would be indistinguishable from the known noise. Additionally, the cross-reclaim protection for stale sessions currently has NO falsifiable test: postgres_stale_source_does_not_cross_reclaim_healthy_sibling_lane would pass even if that protection were removed, so a regression there would ship silently. Additionally, shared test-support modules auto-discovered as standalone default-feature test targets are a standing trap: they compile in a configuration their consumers never use, so a gated import added later breaks the default build of the whole crate and therefore every dependent crate.

implementation_notes: Do not 'fix' this by shortening the 5000 ms ack deadline or making the ack optional - that would delete the durability guarantee these tests exist to prove.
